title: Use composable animations as KP primary artifact
summary: Accepted that KP's durable authored unit is a composable semantic animation, not a tutorial. Tutorials, cards, generated solutions, flashcards, embeds, static steps, GIFs, videos, graph scenes, and program traces are consumers of the same typed animation asset.
